reviews.comment: He was easily one of the best professors I've had during my time at Texas A&M. He truly cares for his students and makes class a fun and welcoming environment for all. I was a little scared to take an argumentation and debate class but he made public speaking not feel so daunting. He even brought us donuts to class for a special occasion.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am an engineering student, and he is the most educated professor I have ever had, who is able to communicate his knowledge in an understandable way for students to understand. His class is an easy A. The 3 exams are debates, and the only other grades are two debate analyses and attendance. You have to try really hard not to get an A in this class

He's easily the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are super interesting, and you'll always laugh at something he'll say. The assignments in this class take like 5 minutes, and the projects are really fun. As long as you're trying, you'll get an A.

Dr. Nic really cares about teaching this class. He makes it so that it is easy to understand, and tries to take away a lot of anxiety around public speaking. Overall, I definitely feel that my ability to speak publicly has improved a lot, and I didn't feel stressed in the class at all.
THE BEST. THATS ALL I CAN SAY.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The only class I've taken at 5:30 that's actually been bearable. Dr Bradley is the nicest professor ever, and he brought donuts once. I heart public speaking

I took this course for the language credit to graduate, and I was not expecting much from it, but I was pleasantly surprised by Dr. Bradley's lectures. He is engaging with his students, and his speech assignments have interesting topics. The assignment difficulty is easy, and you will likely learn some interesting things in the course. Take him!

Phenomenal professor. I came into this semester thinking I would hate this class and it would be a blow off class, but it turned into one that I looked forward to attending. Great lectures from a professor that truly cares about the topic he teaches.
dr. bradley is amazing!! he is very well-spoken and has a great passion for what is covered in class. shoutout the goat frfr
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nicholas Bradley was a great professor. He is very passionate about Public Speaking he likes teaching the class. If you get the chance to take him, I would. Attendance is mandatory, but his lectures are pretty intriguing. The class consists of attendance, question 3 in in-person public speeches, and a final group project.
Phenomenal professor. I came into this class thinking I would hate it and it would be a blow off class but it became a class I looked forward to showing up to.

Prof. Bradley is actually the coolest guy ever. He made a 5:30 pm lecture something that you actually want to show up to. He's super caring and will give you full points if you go within the time limit on the speeches. 10/10 would recommend.
Great class, Dr Bradley makes the class worth attending.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a great professor, has such a passion for COMM and his students

Really nice and caring prof, engages with his students in fun and interactive ways. Donuts were present. Not a super harsh grader, helpful feedback, informational lectures, overall just a really good prof and good dude.

There are 3 in-person speeches, tasks due a the beginning of class (I've turned some in late and still received credit), and a group project at the end of the year. He doesn't want electronics in class, which never was a problem. There are workshops before our speeches so we have some time in class to work on them. If you have the chance take him!

Professor Bradley made the class very easy to follow. Each of the speeches had a clear rubric and he graded leniently. He also brought donuts for the class once. Attendance is mandatory since he assigns take-home tasks due each lecture. His only real rule is no electronic note-taking (so bring a notebook)
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradley was very kind, encouraging, and engaging. He made an effort to make class fun. There were tasks to turn in in class, but they were simple and easy. There were 3 in person speeches and one video project. Public speaking is a challenging topic but Dr. Bradley is a great choice to guide you through it.

Amazing lectures, although he is always adapting year after year. Unfortunately since it's required, a lot of students around you are on laptops, which in such a small space is very distracting. Nic's a very nice guy and always willing to help, changing around his office hours if even one person emails.

Professor Bradley is a great guy who cares about the class and his students. He is very knowledgeable. Easy class to get your comm credit. He did grade attendance this semester. No exams, only speeches. The group project at the end was our "final," but it was simple. He is an easy grader. Gives donuts sometimes, too. Lecture is heavy, however.

Funny and likes what he teaches. I absolutely hate public speaking but after the first speech it was not that bad anymore plus small class. He grades nice and all the work you have to do takes maybe a day at most. Only work you have to do is speeches online and in person. Very nice teacher and lets you make up work whenever if u missed something.

Literally one of the best profs I've had in my time at A&M. Prof Bradley is an amazing guy, SUPER funny, and all the assignments for class are really easy and perfectly doable. Doesn't matter if you love it hate public speaking, his class makes it so easy. I'd give him a higher than 5 rating if I could, he's genuinely that great! Also got us donuts

Professor Bradley is amazing! He is absolutely hilarious and is obviously passionate about what he teaches. He gives you clear criteria for speeches and feels very approachable in general. His class is made up of mostly individual speeches and one group project that you have plenty of time to prepare for. Highly recommend!

Prof. Nic was amazing, he's very lenient with grading and can be understanding with submissions and issues that us as students can have. Obviously, it is very speech-heavy, so just be ready if you're also a fellow anxious public speaker...it's absolutely doable!

Took this class for my COMM credit and man... this guy is great! He is so passionate about communications and he's lectures are very very interesting. He canceled many classes this year due to illness, but still got the material down with limited days. Super easy class, graded mainly by speeches throughout the semester. He brought us donuts too.
Nick Bradley is great professor! The class is not difficult. He gives us many chances to get our assignments completed!

Nic is literally the king of the world. He is so kind and honestly one of the best profs I have had at TAMU. He is actually so passionate about public speaking and makes it so enjoyable. He gives great feedback on his grades and is always willing to help. Would take him a million times over. He's also funny as hell and brought us donuts
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof is such a cool guy! He cares about his students and loves what he does! He helps you enjoy and get comfortable with public speaking. In a way, he encourages the class to become friends by talking about interesting topics. It was refreshing to go to his class. He is goofy, kind, and extremely knowledgeable. I wish I took his class years ago!!

One of my favorite classes I have ever had. Professor Bradley is hilarious, intellectual, and he honestly made this class fun and interesting. There are 2 major projects but he will work with you and makes himself more than accessible to talk if you need help. 10/10 would reccommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: COMM 203 with him was amazing. Just did the summer boot camp and his assignments were fun, interesting, and engaging. His grading was generous and his distributions are far better than most teachers in this class. Do yourself a favor and take him!
Nicholas is a swell guy. Great personality, funny lecturer, fair grader, and gives us donuts from time to time to make up for his swearing problem. 10/10 guy I cant lie
